steps.t: Tell us what matters to your family
steps.d: Pick your neighborhood and priorities on the Find schools page.
Tap Save on any school. Aim for 4 to 8 schools.
Tap “I'm going” to plan a visit. After the visit, tap “Yes, I went.” This step checks itself off when every planned visit is done.
Some schools take students only by audition, or only by screen (grades and attendance). Find out what each one needs before you apply.
On My list, use the arrows to move your true favorite to the top. Adding more schools does not hurt your chances at your top choice.

steps.t: Log in to MySchools and add your programs
steps.d: Log in at myschools.nyc and add the program you want at each school, in your order. The Apply in MySchools guide on My list shows each school's code to search for. New to MySchools? Ask your child's current school for an account creation code. It can take a few days, so ask early.

In MySchools, check the order, click Next, then Submit. MySchools shows a confirmation when it's submitted. Your application counts only once you submit it. The application closes at the end of the day.
